description: This file contains mock implementations for OpenAI API responses, including functions to simulate streaming responses, response building, and fetch interception for testing purposes.

methods.name: extractLastUserText
methods.description: Extracts the last user input text from an array of message objects.

methods.name: extractToolOutput
methods.description: Extracts the output string from a function call output message.

methods.name: fakeOpenAIResponsesStream
methods.description: Simulates a stream of OpenAI responses based on input parameters.

methods.name: decodeBodyText
methods.description: Decodes various body formats into a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: buildSseResponse
methods.description: Builds a server-sent events (SSE) Response from a list of events.

methods.name: buildOpenAIResponsesTextSse
methods.description: Creates an SSE Response with a fixed message content.

methods.name: buildOpenAIResponsesSse
methods.description: Generates a Response object streaming simulated OpenAI responses.

methods.name: installOpenAiResponsesMock
methods.description: Overrides global fetch to mock OpenAI responses for testing.
